title_sq: Apartament 1+1 ne shitje 21 Dhjetori ne Tirane
description_sq:
21 Dhjetori, Rruga Kongresi i Lushnjes , shitet apartament 1+1 me siperfaqe 58.3, kati i 4(jo i fundit ) pallat egzistues. Organizohet nga korridor shperndares, soxhorno, dhome gjumi, tualet, depo dhe ballkon. Orentimi Lindje-Perendim. Apartamenti eshte totalisht i restauruar nga e para duke filluar nga instalime elektrike, hidraulike, dyer, dritare, parket etj.
Shitet 140 000 euro
title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale December 21 in Tirana
description_en: 21 December, Rruga Kongresi i Lushnje, 1+1 apartment for sale with a surface area of ​​58.3, 4th floor (not the last) existing building. It is organized by distribution corridor, living room, bedroom, toilet, storage room and balcony. Orientation East-West. The apartment has been completely restored from scratch, starting with electrical, plumbing, doors, windows, flooring, etc. For sale, 140,000 euros
